Requirements:

1. Support real-time payments on a modern core banking platform using event-driven integration and Kafka.

2. Provide DORA operational-resilience control mapping and automated ICT risk evidence collection.

3. Extract structured information from scanned insurance claim forms and route low-confidence cases for human review.

4. Improve observability of critical payment services and reduce incident detection times.

5. Provide blockchain-based digital-asset custody and cryptocurrency wallet operations.

6. Migrate a manufacturing company from SAP ERP to an aerospace supply-chain platform.
